collection.title: Audi A3 Sportback 2004 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2004 to 2012 version of the Audi A3 Sportback which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this A3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
